# The kernel of the level coordinate is the principal ideal generated by `ω_n = (1 + T) ^ pⁿ - 1`

```lean
TauCeti.Iwasawa.ker_levelCoordinate.{u_1} {p : ℕ} [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {O : Type u_1} [CommRing O]
  [IsLocalRing O] (hp : ↑p ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)
  [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] (n : ℕ) :
  RingHom.ker (TauCeti.Iwasawa.levelCoordinate hp n) = Ideal.span {(1 + PowerSeries.X) ^ p ^ n - 1}
```
